about: An adult with schizophrenia switched from risperidone to periciazine on 14 September 2025 with a documented missed baseline and a later prolactin result on 4 November.
Possible finding: the first Solian supply follows four months without it, and the record holds no line about a documented start, a qualifying diagnosis or baseline prolactin.
Serenace (haloperidol) is first supplied on 11 February 2026 and a baseline prolactin was recorded on 21 January 2026, three weeks before the start, so there is no finding.
